Stats

Githyanki_Gishra_Caster
Zephyr Gish'ra or Ember Gish'ra are a class-like archetype of githyanki characters encountered throughout Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Zephyr and Ember Gish'ra are Way of the Four Elements Monks.

They only appear during the attack on the Astral Prism in Act Three and come in two varieties, one that uses ⁠Fire (Ember) and the other that uses Wind/Air (Zephyr).
